ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows three identical-looking gas bulbs connected in a row by stopcocks. The left bulb is labeled 20.0 g He, the middle bulb is labeled 40.0 g Ne, and the right bulb is labeled 30.0 g NO. The problem states that each container is 1.0 L, the stopcocks are originally closed, all gases are at 25°C, and ideal behavior is assumed. Reasoning: Because the containers are separate with closed stopcocks, and each gas has the same volume and temperature, the ideal gas law P = nRT/V means pressure is proportional only to the number of moles n. For He: n = 20.0 g / 4.00 g/mol = 5.0 mol. For Ne: n = 40.0 g / 20.18 g/mol ≈ 2.0 mol. For NO: n = 30.0 g / 30.0 g/mol ≈ 1.0 mol. Helium has the greatest number of moles, so it exerts the greatest pressure.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: three identical-looking gas bulbs are labeled 20.0 g He, 40.0 g Ne, and 30.0 g NO. From the text, note that each container is 1.0 L, the stopcocks are initially closed, all gases are at 25°C, and ideal behavior is assumed. Since V and T are the same for all three separate gases, compare n using P = nRT/V. Calculate moles: He = 20.0/4.00 = 5.0 mol; Ne = 40.0/20.18 ≈ 2.0 mol; NO = 30.0/30.0 ≈ 1.0 mol. The largest n gives the largest P, so He exerts the greatest pressure.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the left bulb contains 20.0 g of He, the middle bulb 40.0 g of Ne, and the right bulb 30.0 g of NO, with stopcocks separating them. From the text, note that the bulbs are identical 1.0 L containers and all are at 25°C. For ideal gases at equal temperature and volume, the gas with the most particles has the greatest pressure. Estimate particle amounts in Avogadro units: 20.0 g He is about 5 mol because He is 4 g/mol; 40.0 g Ne is about 2 mol because Ne is about 20 g/mol; 30.0 g NO is about 1 mol because NO is about 30 g/mol. method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有三个相同外观的圆形容器横向连接，容器之间各有一个关闭的 stopcock。左侧容器标有“20.0 g He”，中间容器标有“40.0 g Ne”，右侧容器标有“30.0 g NO”。题干说明三个容器都是相同的 1.0 L，气体都在 25°C，并假设理想气体行为。

推理：理想气体满足 PV = nRT。因为三个容器的体积相同、温度相同，所以压力 P 与物质的量 n 成正比。计算各气体的物质的量：He 的摩尔质量约为 4.00 g/mol，因此 20.0 g He 约为 5.0 mol；Ne 的摩尔质量约为 20.2 g/mol，因此 40.0 g Ne 约为 2.0 mol；NO 的摩尔质量约为 30.0 g/mol，因此 30.0 g NO 约为 1.0 mol。He 的物质的量最大，所以它的压力最大。
